programmes.d: Tony sees a cash exchange between a murder suspect and Rachel's cousin, a car dealer who's been spending big money. Meanwhile, a 40th birthday looms for Tony.
A series of violent attacks outside a gay bar has the squad scrambling for clues, while one officer makes a confession.
The janitor at the police station reports that he witnessed a woman's murder. But at the trial, the defendant's lawyer gives him a particularly hard time because he has Down Syndrome.
In his bid for the governor's seat, Peter Alatorre plans to reveal Vinnie as a mob boss.
Cerrico moves to consolidate his power within the commission and asks Don Aiuppo for his blessing, but the unforgiving don plans his payback.
On the advice of a therapist, Vinnie and Amber agree to confront their true feelings for each other on a retreat in Vermont.
Captain Devane tries to take Hunter and McCall off the investigation of his ex-wife's murder and violates his forced leave of absence to pursue the killer himself.
A Colombian drug dealer is murdered and police informant Sporty James becomes the prime suspect, hunted by both Hunter and the criminals.
Hunter and McCall's investigation of the stabbing of a deaf man hinges on cryptic clues the victim gave in sign language before he died.
